thread:
Harper (Marketing): Quick thread to finalize landing microcopy + 2 social variants for our Hosted/Dedicated/Private push. Focus: webinar as primary funnel for Dedicated, signups for Hosted, contact form for Private.
Leo (Growth): Routing plan: hosted -> self-serve; dedicated -> demo request to SDR queue; private -> AE + security packet. Add hidden form field 'deployment_interest'.
Riya (PM): Webinar tentatively Thu 10am PT. Slides should include conservative benchmark table (latency, cost/token, p95) and one app example (vector search ~6k tokens). Keep language "early customer observed" for anecdotes.
Sam (Design): Hero candidates:
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features in hours"
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput for production"
- Private: "Inference inside your VPC"
Compact banner idea: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference."
Noel (EngOps): Webhook mapping ready. Field slugs: deployment_interest, workload_type, variant_id. Example tag: interest:dedicated.
Harper (Marketing): Draft launch X post: "One API. Any deployment. See latency & cost benchmarks live. Register: <link>" LinkedIn longer: include "migration playbook" and demo invite.
Leo (Growth): A/B CTAs: "Register — See Benchmarks" vs "Register — Get Migration Playbook". We'll track variant and route leads accordingly.
Riya (PM): Action items: 1) Sam upload hero comps 2) Noel confirm slugs + webhook 3) Leo draft two social captions 4) Harper push copy to staging and share preview. Dry run Wed 9am PT.
notify-bot: Reminder set for Wednesday 2024-08-14 09:00:00 PT — Tri-mode launch dry run.
Harper (Marketing): Posting landing microcopy v1: "Deliver production-grade inference across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private with a single API. Choose Hosted for rapid self-serve launches, Dedicated for predictable throughput and SLAs, or Private to keep inference inside your VPC. Join our webinar for benchmark demos and a migration playbook."
